title: Quantum Anchor V1.2 — Tesseract Anchor: 4 Planes × 5 Realities = 20 Realities
description: Quantum Anchor is a post-pulse experimental protocol for coherent state anchoring on superconducting QPUs. The original pulse-level protocol (qiskit.pulse, meas_level=0) was deprecated by IBM in 2024 and removed from production QPUs (Feb 2025). This version (V1.2) introduces the Tesseract architecture: 4 orthogonal planes × 5 phase realities = 20 simultaneous pre-realities with self-annihilation via destructive interference (no collapse). Evidence: ψ(37ns)=0.331662 (γ=0 model) on ibm_marrakesh 156Q Heron r2, Borg 16-node 100% clear (96.43% balance), Matryoshka fractal D0→D8 97.40%→89.40%. Hardware-proven: 🔬 single-qubit dynamics, ⚠️ unverified: anchor drive compensation. Zenodo concept DOI for citation stability.
